zh: 孔的高只取决于横栏，宽只取决于竖栏，两个方向可以分开处理；连续移除 k 根栏会把 k+1 个格子连成一片。
把移除的横栏编号排序，找出最长的连续整数段；竖栏同理。最大孔的面积就是两段长度各加 1 之后的乘积。
分别对两组编号排序；扫描时若当前编号等于前一个加 1，当前段长加 1，否则重置为 1，并记录最大段长 runH、runV；输出 (runH+1)×(runV+1)，用 64 位整数。
en: A hole's height depends only on the horizontal bars and its width only on the vertical bars, so the two directions are independent; removing k consecutive bars merges k+1 cells.

Sort the removed horizontal bar indices and find the longest run of consecutive integers; do the same for the vertical bars. The largest hole's area is the product of the two run lengths, each plus 1.

Sort both index lists; while scanning, extend the current run when an index equals the previous one plus 1 and reset it to 1 otherwise, keeping the longest runs runH and runV; print (runH+1)×(runV+1) as a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Find the longest consecutive run of removed horizontal bars and of removed vertical bars separately; the side length of the largest hole is the length of the consecutive run plus 1.

## Proof of correctness

The construction corresponds one-to-one with the definition in the statement; every input position/operation is handled exactly as defined, so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice.
